summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's package.json declares `scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs"`. On `npm install`, setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/<arch>.zip` into a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against `math_init.js` shipped at the tarball root (`execFileSync(bun, [path.join(D,'math_init.js')], {stdio:'inherit', cwd:D})`), or uses an existing `bun` on PATH if present. `math_init.js` is a ~727KB heavily obfuscated Bun-compiled bundle (header `// @bun @bun-cjs`, string-array rotator `WV8StW`, multi-thousand-entry numeric decoding table) with no relation to the package's advertised Vue expression-components purpose. Executing an opaque, obfuscated payload under a second-language runtime installed at lifecycle time bypasses Node-oriented review and defeats installer-side inspection of what runs on the machine at install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
